about: V4-282 conformance corpus: synthetic request bodies shaped on Claude Code 2.1.283's, one corpus for splice's gate leg (tools/e2e conformance) and rig-lead's head-side half. No provider, no private data: every string here is invented. A class fixture is one Anthropic Messages request plus, per dialect, the checks its upstream request must pass. A string `@id` in a check or in the request is replaced by carriers[id] before use.
clientSystem:
KEEP-ALPHA the client's opening instructions.

STRIP-TARGET a paragraph an operator's pattern removes.

KEEP-OMEGA the client's closing instructions.
